name: Unifinz Capital India Limited
summary: Unifinz Capital India Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. It offers instant personal loans to salaried customers. The company also conducts its lending operations through its credit-enabled financial technology platform operated under the lendingplate brand name. In addition, it offers long term, short term, and instant cash loans to professionals. The company was formerly known as Shree Worstex Limited and changed its name to Unifinz Capital India Limited in December 2022. Unifinz Capital India Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in New Delhi, India.
